title: Mother & Children on Suburban Porch, c. 1958 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid late-1950s black-and-white snapshot depicting a young mother interacting with her two small children outside their suburban home. The mother, wearing a classic mid-century shirtwaist dress, stands near the edge of the lawn looking toward her son and toddler daughter who are standing on the covered brick front porch. The home features classic post-WWII American architecture with board-and-batten siding, shutters, multi-pane windows, and a small sapling planted in the yard beside stepping stones.
